# Sibel Açıkalın Akgün — Artist

> Sibel Açıkalın Akgün (b. 1983, Istanbul, Turkey) is a multidisciplinary artist
> working across sculpture, painting, illustration, and print. Her current series,
> "Too Much Emotion" (2023–2026), spans cast polyester sculpture, acrylic painting
> and fine art prints. She lives and works in Istanbul.
> Site: https://sibelacikalinakgun.com/

## Artist statement — Too Much Emotion (2023–2026)

Too Much Emotion is shaped around my experience of breaking apart and rebuilding.
The transition between figurative and abstract forms reveals the relationship I
create between my inner world and the outside world. My sculpture and painting
practices develop simultaneously. For me, making is not only a form of expression,
but also a way of returning to the beginning and rebuilding myself again and again.
In this series, my sculptures embody an inward-looking, concentrated, and
self-contained presence, while my paintings bring impressions of the outside world
to the surface through movement and the passage of time. My relationship with
nature and my shifting emotional states emerge as fluidity and movement across the
surface. This flow unfolds like the movement of fleeting emotions over time,
leaving traces behind and carrying the memory of places through lived experiences.
Too Much Emotion emerges from within this ongoing process and carries the courage
to meet the viewer.

## Works — Sculpture (Too Much Emotion)

- Drowning, Splitting, Multiplying — 2025, cast polyester, 50 × 21 × 18 cm
- Hiding — 2025, cast polyester, 32 × 16 × 15 cm
- Flow — 2025, cast polyester, 62 × 14 × 15 cm
- Leave Me Alone — 2025, cast polyester, 19 × 9 × 15 cm

## Works — Painting (Too Much Emotion)

- Poppy Garden — 2026, acrylic on canvas, 70 × 70 cm
- Dark Forest — 2025, acrylic on canvas, 80 × 50 cm
- Plomari Attack — 2025, acrylic on canvas, 120 × 60 cm

## Works — Prints

- Green Tomatoes & Basil — fine art print, edition of 50, signed and numbered

## Education

- MFA in Sculpture — Mimar Sinan Fine Arts University
- BFA in Sculpture — Anadolu University, Faculty of Fine Arts

## Collaborations & publications

Alongside her artistic practice, she has collaborated with agencies, brands, and
publishers on advertising, illustration, children's books, product and brand
communication projects. Her illustrated books have been published in Turkey,
Australia, and South Korea.

- 2026 Kalplere Dokunan Çocuklar (Korean edition), BKbooks, South Korea
- 2024 Good Morning Amelia Island, Hastings Park Press, Australia
- 2024 Kalplere Dokunan Çocuklar, Nobel Çocuk, Ankara, Turkey
- 2023 İstanbul'da Çocukluk, IPA İstanbul Dergisi No. 8, Istanbul Planning Agency, Turkey
- 2022 Pamuk Kalpli Prens ve Yedi Cüceler, Can Yayınları, Istanbul, Turkey
- 2020 Kısa Klasikler: Uysal Kız, Can Yayınları, Istanbul, Turkey
- 2019 Çocuktan Al Bilgiyi series, character design, Timaş Yayınları, Istanbul, Turkey
- 2018 We Miss Wikipedia!, poster illustration, Wikimedia Foundation, USA
- 2017 Pelin ve Çınar Gezi Rehberi series, ABM Yayınları, Istanbul, Turkey
